conviction_note: Nothing here is a confirmed unpriced number. The FY26 actual probably beats the July-revised plan, because the plan implies a Q4 operating profit of only 47m yen against 100m a year earlier and the company beat its last revision by 34% (FY24) and 6.8% (FY25). That is outweighed by the item that actually moves the stock: the first FY27 guide, measured against the company's own medium-term-plan target (OP 660m, sales 6,000m, DPS 20). The company's initial guides have been conservative (FY26 opened at +2.4% OP and fell 6.2% on the day), its own Q3 短信 warns of customer EV-project cancellations from Q4 onward, and the stock trades at about 22x FY26E after a theme rally that more than doubled it from ~1,200 yen. Net findings come to -0.6. p_up 45 on an abs move of 9.0 gives -0.9; the two measurements agree in sign and are about the same size.
bar: Company FY2026/8 forecast as revised 2026-07-14: sales 5,650m, OP 633m, 経常 656m, NP 450m, DPS 18 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260714/140120260709590234.pdf). For the guide, the bar is the medium-term-plan FY2027/8 target: sales 6,000m, OP 660m, DPS 20 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251014/140120251006569161.pdf). There is no 四季報 or IFIS consensus: Yahoo JP's アナリスト予想 is empty and 四季報オンライン is JS/paywalled. The bar is company-sourced only. print_vs_bar_pct is the expected FY26 OP against 633m.
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register as of 2026-09-29: 1.11% across 2 sellers, up from 0.61% (+0.50pt, building into the print; https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html via baseline). irbank lists Citigroup, MS MUFG, Nomura Intl, UBS, JPM and Jane Street as lenders/short institutions (https://irbank.net/4440). Margin balance per kabutan (https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=4440): long 237.4k / short 31.5k shares on 10/02, 信用倍率 7.54, with the long unwinding from 392.4k on 09/04. TSE/JSF imposed a 50% margin requirement from 2026-09-16 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4440&b=n202609160297). Arrowstreet reported 7.54% (314,700 shares) on 10/07, with the obligation date 09/30 (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4440&b=n202610070496). There is no skew. The baseline lean is -1.98 (run-up and short building outweigh the squeeze term). The short is not crowded, so a negative here is not fighting a squeeze setup, but it agrees with the building shorts and is therefore partly priced.

findings.finding: The July-revised FY26 plan implies Q4 (Jun-Aug) operating profit of only 47m yen (633m less 586m cumulative to Q3), against 100m in Q4 FY25 (566m less 466m). WITZ beat its last revised OP by 34% in FY24 and 6.8% in FY25, so the FY26 actual is more likely than not to land above 633m.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Profit surprises against the plan have moved this name hard. The Q1 FY26 OP of 2.0x (2026-01-09, 12:00) went 買い気配 and limit up, about +25%. The Q2 Dec-Feb OP of -44% (2026-04-13) hit limit down intraday. The FY25 actual beat of +6.8% OP on 2025-10-14 still fell -6.2% because the FY26 guide dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: The implied Q4 can be computed by anyone, so this is only partly unpriced. The theme-driven holder base (volume up 100x around 09/03) is not trading the Q4 arithmetic, though. If it were priced as a beat, the stock would be holding the 09/24 high rather than drifting from 2,750 to 2,390 into the print with margin longs unwinding. The Q3 短信's own warning of customer EV-project cancellations from Q4 and the AG社 off-season (May-Aug) are why this is sized small.
findings.independence: The FY24 and FY25 beats come from different documents (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20241011/140120241004594164.pdf and https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251014/140120251009570632.pdf against https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20250714/140120250709510365.pdf). They are a track record, not this year's data.

findings.finding: The first FY27 guide lands against the company's own MTP target of OP 660m (+4% on the FY26 plan), sales 6,000m and DPS 20. The company's initial guides have been conservative: FY26 opened at OP +2.4% and the stock fell 6.2%. Its Q3 短信 says customer EV-related project cancellations leave Q4 onward 'uncertain'. And the stock now trades at about 22x FY26E after a theme rally from ~1,200 to ~2,500 yen with no earnings change. A guide at or below 660m is the likelier outcome and is likely to be sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: At the 2025-10-14 FY print, the FY26 guide of OP +2.4% (set equal to a simultaneously raised MTP) came alongside a +6.8% FY25 beat and the stock moved -6.17% (baseline history; the release date is confirmed on irbank). The 2025-07-14 and 2026-07-14 upward revisions drew 買い気配 / +10% intraday.
findings.why_not_priced: The guide is new information released today; no 四季報/IFIS number for FY27 is reachable, so the market has no anchor beyond the MTP. If the market expected a soft guide, the theme premium (PER about 22 against a 6.9-14x range in 2024-25 per irbank) would already have compressed. It has only partly: the price is down from 2,750 to 2,390 since 09/24, consistent with the shorts building. The upside tail is real and is why the range is wide. The sensing large order slipped into FY27 (Q3 短信), AG社 contributes a full year, the MTP was raised twice in 2025, and the Panasonic Connect and Go-Tech items (Sept) give the company a reason to guide above 660m.
findings.independence: The EV caution is from a different document, the Q3 短信 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260714/140120260709590234.pdf). The 2025-10 reaction comes from the baseline history and the kabutan headline 'ヴィッツ、今期経常は1％増で3期連続最高益、3円増配へ' (https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4440&nmode=0&date=20251000). The valuation premium is from https://irbank.net/4440.

findings.finding: The dividend policy is DOE 2.4%. On the Q3 equity (3,188m) and FY-start equity (2,825m) that implies about 18 yen for FY26, already in the forecast, and about 20 yen for FY27, matching the MTP. A 増配 like FY24's (13 to 14 after a 62% NP beat) is possible only on a large beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2024-10-11 増配 to 14 yen came with the FY24 print; the baseline reaction for that print is +3.70% (estimated date 2024-10-11). The yield is 0.73%, so returns are a minor line for this holder base.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the policy is public and the arithmetic lands on the existing forecast. It is filed because a small 増配 on the FY26 actual is the one shareholder-return item the release could add. A 0.73% yield on a theme stock limits what it can be worth.
findings.independence: The equity figures come from the Q3 短信 (https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20260714/140120260709590234.pdf); the MTP DPS of 20 is from https://f.irbank.net/pdf/20251014/140120251006569161.pdf.

findings.finding: Arrowstreet Capital crossed 5% at 7.54% (314,700 shares, obligation date 2026-09-30, filed 10/07), so a systematic holder owns about 7.5% of shares and roughly 1.3x the current margin long balance.
findings.why_not_priced: It is public since 10/07, so it is largely priced. It is filed because, with Aisin and Okuma also holding, it tightens an already thin float, which raises the move in both directions more than it sets a sign. A quant holder can sell as easily as add, hence the near-zero size.

outside_window.finding: FY27 is the final year of the FY25-27 MTP. A new MTP (the last one was released 2024-11-19, separately from results) could come after the window.

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: none pre-filed. The FY26 actual likely lands above the 07-14 plan (OP 633m), in line with the company's 2/2 record of beating its last revision. Returns: DOE 2.4% implies about 18 yen FY26 (unchanged) and about 20 yen FY27 (= MTP); a buyback is possible but there is no sign of one (the last was 2023-12 to 2024-10). New-year guide: this is the item that decides the print. The bar is the MTP FY27 target of OP 660m / sales 6,000m, and the company's own July EV-cancellation caution and conservative opening-guide habit lean below it. Quarter vs own 進捗率: Q3 OP progress is 92.6% of the revised plan; FY25's Q3 progress against its final July plan was 87.9% (466/530) and it beat. Implied Q4 is the weakest in two years.
baseline_tension: The net negative agrees with the baseline lean (-1.98), the building short register and the unwinding margin longs, so it is partly priced, and the large theme run-up (+24% over 20d, about +100% since 08/27) cuts both ways. The strongest positive I looked for and weighed: a guide above the 660m MTP (the sensing order that slipped into FY27, a full year of AG社, two MTP raises in 2025), a FY26 beat with a small 増配, and the thin float. That is why p_up is only 45 and the guide finding's range runs to +5.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on a public series): the guide negative partly rests on the EV-cancellation caution already public in the July Q3 短信, though the guide itself is new. The guidance finding moved from -2.5 to -2.0 and p_up from 43 to 45.

Rule 2 (negatives outnumber positives): I checked the sign. Three of four findings are positive and the only negative is the guide. The strongest positive (a guide above the MTP, a beat with 増配) is now written into baseline_tension and the guide finding's high range. No further change.
Open question 4 (run-in as a short signal): noted. The 5d run-up is +2.2% and is not used as a finding.
